name: Pilferer’s Gloves
body:
Price 8,400 gp; Slot hands; CL 5th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura moderate abjuration

DESCRIPTION

These smooth gloves have small pockets on the inside that contain a concealable set of masterwork thieves’ tools which are almost impossible to find, granting a +10 bonus on Sleight of Hand or Stealth checks to hide them when being searched. Whenever the wearer attempts a Disable Device or Sleight of Hand check or steal combat maneuver to take an item, open a door, or otherwise disturb an item that has been warded with an alarm, magic mouth, or similar triggered alarm, he is immediately alerted to its presence and can attempt a caster level check (using the caster level of the gloves) as a swift action to dispel that alarm, as dispel magic. If the check fails, he cannot dispel the magical alarm but can attempt to disarm it as if it were a magical trap (Disable Device DC 25 + spell level). Additionally, whenever the wearer is making a Disable Device check, he may choose to shroud the space he occupies with magical silence that lasts as long as it takes to complete the check, until the beginning of his next turn. He gains a +5 circumstance bonus on Stealth checks made to open a door (or similar aperture) without being noticed.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 4,200 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells dispel magic, secret chest, silence
